_meta.note: All fetched data needs owner confirmation before being marked verified

confirmed.name: M416 - Silent Anabasis
confirmed.effect: 12% chance to trigger Frost Vortex. Generates Ice Crystals (1.5s CD, 15s duration, 40% DMG to Metas). Explode for 100% Psi as Frost Vortex DMG. Premature detonation = 350%. Frost Elemental DMG +30%, +8% per shattered crystal (3 stacks, 15s).

confirmed.name: MG4 - Conflicting Memories
confirmed.effect: Trigger Shrapnel after hitting target 12 times (60% Shrapnel DMG to Metas). For every 25 rounds in magazine, Shrapnel triggers on 1 additional body part, up to 6. If magazine >90 rounds, per 15 extra rounds Shrapnel DMG +10%. Magazine capacity +40.

confirmed.name: DE.50 - Jaws
confirmed.effect: Every 3 weapon hits trigger Unstable Bomber. Crit shots count as 2 hits. 30% chance on crit to trigger UB. Unlocks crit for Unstable Bomber, +35% Crit Rate (stacks with character).

confirmed.name: SOCR - The Last Valor
confirmed.effect: Hitting 4 times triggers Shrapnel. Crit hits count as 2. After crit, Shrapnel additionally triggers 1 more time. Shrapnel Crit DMG +30%.

confirmed.name: MPS7 - Outer Space
confirmed.effect: 30% chance to apply Power Surge on hit. After hitting Power Surge target 12 times, summon lightning dealing 500% Psi Shock DMG (40% vs Metas). After reload, Power Surge bonus +40% for 6s. Shock Elemental DMG +30%.

confirmed.name: SKS - Pathfinder
confirmed.effect: On hit triggers Frost Vortex (5s CD, reduced 1s per hit). 60% chance to generate Deviant Particles. Charged shot = penetrating ice spike 110% Attack as Ice DMG (20% vs Metas). Ice Elemental DMG +30%, +8% after charged shot (3 stacks, 15s).

confirmed.name: TEC9 - Additional Rules
confirmed.effect: On hit triggers Fortress Warfare (10s CD). After Deviant skill, bullets deal 120% Attack as Elemental Status DMG. Empty mag reload restores 25% as Deviant Power (max 20/reload). In Fortress state, Crit Rate +15%.

confirmed.name: G17 - Hazardous Object
confirmed.effect: 20% chance to trigger UB on hit. Reload replaced by throwing weapon for UB DMG in 3m radius (50%+ammo×18% Psi, cap 480%, 28% vs Metas). UB DMG and Range +10% per UB hit, max 5 stacks.

confirmed.name: KAM - Abyss Glance
confirmed.effect: On hit triggers Frost Vortex (7s CD, reduced 0.5s per hit, 30% DMG to Metas). Non-Meta hits in Frost Vortex increase final Frost Vortex DMG +5%, up to 10 stacks. Frost Elemental DMG +30%, Frost Vortex frequency +100%.

confirmed.name: MG4 - Predator
confirmed.effect: 40% chance to trigger Fast Gunner on hit. At every 5 Fast Gunner stacks, gain Unlimited Ammo for 0.5s. Consecutive hits on same target: Weapon DMG +4%, max 20 stacks (halved on switch). When bullets >40% magazine, Attack +60%.
